📺 Breaking Bad – Season 5 (2012–2013)

🎬 TV Series
⭐️ Genre: Crime, Drama, Thriller
🎭 Starring: Bryan Cranston, Aaron Paul, Anna Gunn

📝 Summary:
Season 5 of Breaking Bad follows Walter White as he reaches the height of his drug empire and becomes more powerful and ruthless than ever. With Jesse Pinkman and Mike Ehrmantraut by his side, Walt builds a massive meth operation while facing dangerous enemies, growing suspicion, and the consequences of his increasingly reckless decisions. As his empire begins to collapse, Walt is forced to confront the devastating impact of everything he has built.

🔥 Why Watch?

* One of the most intense final seasons in TV history
* Outstanding performances from the entire cast
* High-stakes crime and suspense
* Powerful character transformations
* Packed with unforgettable twists and emotional moments
